# GET /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{index}

Get a single pull request by index

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-223`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| index | path | integer | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`
